meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,每次用编辑工具成功修改代码,插件会自动检查注释;若发现警告,Codex 会收到阻塞反馈,需先修复或解释该注释再继续。
howto.when: 当成功调用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑工具后,且注释检查器发出警告时触发。

say.text: 修复注释检查器刚指出的问题。
say.note: 触发 Codex 处理阻塞性反馈。

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为什么被标记。
say.note: Codex 会说明原因并决定去留。

say.text: 先解决注释警告,再继续下一步。
say.note: 确保警告被处理后才推进。

howto.what_en: After a successful edit via apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit, this plugin runs a comment check. If it raises a warning, Codex receives blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after a successful edit-like PostToolUse hook, specifically after apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit calls, when the comment-checker emits warnings.

say_en.text: Fix the issue the comment checker just flagged.
say_en.note: Prompts Codex to handle the blocking feedback.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was flagged.
say_en.note: Codex will give reasons and decide to keep or change it.

say_en.text: Resolve the comment warning before continuing.
say_en.note: Ensures the warning is handled before moving on.
